user.title: Set up Lidl Plus
user.description: Get a refresh token with the command line tool: `lidl-plus --language=de --country=DE --user=you@example.com auth`

reauth_confirm.title: Renew the Lidl Plus login
reauth_confirm.description: Lidl Plus rejected the refresh token of {title}. Get a new one with `lidl-plus ... auth` and enter it here.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Lidl Plus
reconfigure.description: Leave the refresh token empty to keep the current one.

error.invalid_auth: The refresh token is invalid or expired. Please get a new one.
error.invalid_country: No Lidl Plus account found for this country. Please check the country code.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to Lidl Plus. Please try again later.
error.unknown: Unexpected error, see the log for details.

abort.already_configured: This Lidl Plus account is already configured, its refresh token was updated.
abort.reauth_successful: The Lidl Plus login was renewed.
abort.wrong_account: The refresh token belongs to a different Lidl Plus account.

init.title: Stores for the offers
init.description: Choose the stores whose current and upcoming offers are loaded. Without a selection the store you visit most is used.

data_description.search: City, postal code or street. The stores found are added to the list, select them and save.

error.no_stores: No store found, please try another city, postal code or street.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to Lidl Plus. Please try again later.

sync.name: Sync receipts
sync.description: Fetches new receipts, coupons, offers, leaflets and statistics from Lidl Plus immediately.

activate_all_coupons.name: Activate all coupons
activate_all_coupons.description: Activates every currently valid coupon of all configured Lidl Plus accounts.

export.name: Export data
export.description: Writes the receipts, articles, offers and leaflets of every Lidl Plus account to files in the folder lidl_plus_export of the configuration.

dataset.name: Data
dataset.description: What to export, everything is written to a ZIP file with a CSV file per table and all raw data.

format.name: Format
format.description: File format of a single table, CSV opens in spreadsheet programs.
